derived_observations: Observed Day4-8 non-WHEAT production comes entirely from assets whose public origin day is before Day4; new Day4-8 cohorts contribute zero observed production during the interval in all 10 cases.
Opponent existing cohort produces 46.0 non-WHEAT units versus self 16.3 during Day4-8, with opponent ahead in all 10 cases.
At Day8 the same existing cohort still retains far more future production potential: current-price mark 24653.8 versus 10517.2, with opponent ahead in all 10 cases.
The new Day4-8 cohort behaves as future-value build rather than current-return source over this window: zero production by Day8 but Day8 remaining potential mark 13300.2 opponent versus 5178.8 self.
Thus opponent simultaneously has a larger mature/returning cohort and builds a larger next cohort while the first cohort is still returning value.
Period non-WHEAT SELL remains unassigned to cohorts because inventory is fungible; only production/harvest and Day8 future potential are cohort-attributed by public asset origin time.
The result supports an overlapping-cohort State structure, not a claim that a specific asset is independently optimal.
boundary: No Candidate, Direction, score, or policy mutation was introduced.
Existing cohort means asset_origin_day < 4; new cohort means 4 <= asset_origin_day < 8.
SELL is not attributed to cohort.
Future potential is current-price remaining production potential, not guaranteed realized profit.
No asset is ranked or assigned causal status.
